name: Crosul Regina Maria
description: Crosul Regina Maria este un eveniment de alergare organizat în Cluj-Napoca, care aduce împreună comunitatea locală de alergători pentru o competiție plină de energie și spirit sportiv. Traseul pornește din zona Sălii Sporturilor “Horia Demian” și oferă participanților o experiență plăcută, cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și bine organizată. Evenimentul este susținut de sponsori oficiali și parteneri, asigurând o bună desfășurare și facilități pentru alergători. Este o ocazie excelentă pentru sportivi de toate nivelurile să se bucure de alergare în aer liber și să se conecteze cu alți pasionați.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing este o cursă unică de anduranță și strategie, unde fiecare tură de 6,7 km trebuie parcursă în maxim o oră. Participanții aleargă la fiecare oră fixă, iar cei care nu reușesc să termine în timp sau renunță sunt eliminați. Cursa continuă până rămâne un singur alergător în picioare, testând limitele fizice și mentale ale concurenților. Evenimentul face parte din Zalău Ultra Trail, o platformă care unește sportul, comunitatea și natura.

name: Veverița Night Run
description: Veverița Night Run este un concurs de alergare montană nocturnă în Bucovina, desfășurat în orașul Vatra Dornei. Evenimentul oferă două curse de dificultate medie, de 12 km și 22 km, pe trasee predominant de potecă montană, cu porțiuni de pădure și pajiști deschise. Startul și finish-ul sunt la baza pârtiei Veverița, iar traseul ajunge până la Vârful Diecilor, la o altitudine de 1301 metri. Participanții trebuie să fie pregătiți pentru alergare montană pe timp de noapte, cu echipament adecvat, inclusiv lanternă frontală și telefon mobil.

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run este un eveniment sportiv comunitar care promovează un stil de viață sănătos prin alergare, adresat tuturor vârstelor și nivelurilor de pregătire. Evenimentul are loc la Vladimirescu, Arad, și include curse pentru copii, familii și alergători amatori sau experimentați. Fiecare ediție susține cauze sociale, transformând alergarea într-un gest de solidaritate și sprijin pentru comunitate. Participanții se bucură de o atmosferă prietenoasă și incluzivă, cu trasee adaptate pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de performanță.

name: JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: A VII. Jászfényszarui Futófesztivál egy szabadidős futóesemény, amelyet Jászfényszarún, a Szentcsalád téren rendeznek meg. A verseny több korosztály számára kínál távokat, az óvodásoktól a felnőttekig, aszfaltozott és rövid földutas szakaszokkal. A negyedmaratoni távon chipes időmérés, frissítőpontok és érmek várják a résztvevőket, a verseny ingyenes minden távon. A rendezvény célja a közösségi sportolás és a futás népszerűsítése, emléket állítva Maróti Istvánnak.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
description: A MAPEI Tihanyi Félmaraton egy hagyományos, 11. alkalommal megrendezett futóverseny Tihanyban, amely változatos távokat kínál a kezdőktől a haladókig. A verseny különlegessége a Balaton-felvidék gyönyörű panorámája és a kihívást jelentő, változatos terep, amely a félsziget legszebb részeit érinti. A félmaraton távját sokan választják első félmaratonjuknak, hiszen a pálya összetétele és a látványos szakaszok felejthetetlen élményt nyújtanak. A rendezvény családbarát, a legkisebbeknek babyrun is van, és minden távon befutóéremmel, frissítéssel, valamint futópólóval várják a résztvevőket.

name: MVM Sopron Félmaraton
location: Városi Stadion, Káposztás u. 4., Sopron, Hungary

name: Balkaniada
description: Балканиада 2026 е планинско състезание по скайрънинг, което се провежда в сърцето на Национален парк Централен Балкан, близо до град Карлово. Състезанието предлага предизвикателни трасета с впечатляващи природни гледки и разнообразен релеф, подходящи за планински бегачи и любители на аутдор спортовете. След успешното домакинство на Световното първенство по скайрънинг за ветерани през 2025 г., Балканиада се утвърждава като едно от водещите планински състезания на Балканите. Участниците могат да избират между няколко дистанции с различна дължина и изкачване, които предлагат уникално изживяване сред дивата природа.

name: Шосеен пробег „Варна”
description: Шосеен пробег „Варна“ е традиционно състезание, провеждано в морската градина на Варна, което привлича едни от най-добрите бегачи в България. Състезанието включва различни дистанции, подходящи за мъже, жени и младежи, като предлага възможност за изява на атлети от различни възрастови групи и клубове. Събитието е част от спортния календар и популяризира леката атлетика в региона.

name: Brașov Running Festival
description: Brașov Running Festival este un eveniment de alergare pe șosea de top, care aduce la Brașov mii de alergători, de la amatori la atleți de elită, într-o atmosferă plină de energie, muzică și distracție. Festivalul include curse diverse, de la 5 km pentru începători, curse pentru copii, până la tRUNsylvania 10K, singura cursă de șosea din România certificată World Athletics Elite Label. Evenimentul se desfășoară pe străzile orașului Tractorul din Brașov și oferă o experiență completă cu zone de încurajare, spectacole live și transmisiuni TV. Este o sărbătoare a alergării care combină performanța sportivă cu bucuria comunității.

name: MARZESTI TRAIL RUN ALEARGĂ, FII PARTE DIN NATURĂ!
description: Mârzeşti Trail Run este o competiție anuală de alergare Cross Country ce se desfășoară în zona Breazu, comuna Rediu, județul Iași, cu startul și sosirea în fața cantonului silvic din Pădurea Mârzeşti. Traseele variate includ zone împădurite, pajiști, drumuri forestiere și agricole, oferind o experiență unică de alergare în natură, cu porțiuni plane, coborâri și rampe. Evenimentul promovează sportul în aer liber și susține cauze sociale locale, fiind o oportunitate de bucurie și întâlnire pentru pasionații de alergare. Distanța semimaratonului și celelalte curse sunt potrivite pentru diferite niveluri de antrenament, iar organizarea include puncte de hidratare și arbitri pe traseu.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon este o competiție de alergare organizată în Timișoara, care promovează un stil de viață sănătos și libertatea de a te descoperi prin mișcare. Evenimentul oferă curse pentru toate nivelurile, de la copii la alergători experimentați, cu distanțe variind de la 200 de metri până la maraton complet de 42 km. Comunitatea UVT Liberty Marathon este dedicată susținerii și motivării participanților să-și atingă potențialul și să se bucure de alergare într-un cadru prietenos și energic. Traseele sunt concepute pentru a provoca și inspira, iar atmosfera este una de susținere și libertate.

name: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv
description: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv е корпоративно щафетно бягане и тимбилдинг събитие, което се провежда в завода на LIEBHERR в Пловдив. Състезанието включва отбори от по 4 души, като всеки участник бяга по 4 км, обикаляйки два пъти около равнинния маршрут от 2 км. Това е най-голямото корпоративно бягане в Южна България, което съчетава спорт, забавление и благотворителност. Събитието се провежда от 2017 г. в Пловдив и привлича компании от цялата страна.

name: Неофит Рилски маратон и колоездене 2026
description: Неофит Рилски маратон и колоездене 2026 предлага уникално приключение с трасета, които преминават през красивата българска природа от село Неофит Рилски до крепостта Овеч. Състезанията включват бягане и колоездене на различни дистанции, стартиращи и завършващи в Исторически парк. Участниците ще се изправят пред предизвикателства с различна денивелация и контролно време, подходящи за различни нива на подготовка. За децата е предвидено детско бягане с лакомства. Събитието е подходящо за любители на спорта и природата, които търсят сериозно предизвикателство и приключение.

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Maraton este un eveniment sportiv de alergare montană organizat în Valea Cernei, Băile Herculane, de Clubul Sportiv Alternative Timișoara. Concursul include probe de Maraton (44 km) și Semimaraton (22 km) desfășurate pe trasee montane ce străbat Munții Cernei și leagă cele 39 de cătune din zonă. Este unul dintre primele maratoane montane din regiune, oferind o experiență autentică de trail running în peisaje naturale spectaculoase. Evenimentul este dedicat alergătorilor pasionați de teren montan și aventură.

name: Crosul „INIMILOR MARI” 2026
location: Parcul Central Simion Bărnuțiu, Parcul Central, Cluj-Napoca, România

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: A SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál egy kétnapos futóesemény, amely 2026. október 10-11-én kerül megrendezésre Budapesten. A verseny során a résztvevők Budapest legszebb, világörökségi helyszínei mentén futhatnak, miközben élvezhetik a város panorámáját és a hangulatos szurkolást. A fesztivál a futás ünnepe, ahol mindenki megtalálhatja a számára legmegfelelőbb távot az 5 km-től a maratonig. A rendezvényen egyedi befutóérem és futópóló várja a résztvevőket, emellett számos kísérőprogram és zenei élmény teszi felejthetetlenné a hétvégét.

name: Bucharest Marathon
description: Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon este un eveniment sportiv emblematic care se desfășoară anual în București, oferind curse pentru toate nivelurile de alergători. Traseele includ maratonul complet de 42 km, semimaratonul de 21 km, cursa de 10 km, cursa populară și ștafeta 4x, toate având startul în Piața Constituției. Evenimentul este cunoscut pentru atmosfera sa vibrantă, susținerea comunității și implicarea în cauze caritabile. Participanții pot experimenta un traseu urban ce traversează puncte importante ale capitalei, cu puncte de hidratare și suport pe parcurs.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: A 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál egy egész hétvégén át tartó futóesemény, amely október 11-én kerül megrendezésre Budapesten. A versenyen 5 és 42,195 km közötti távokon lehet nevezni, így mindenki megtalálhatja a számára megfelelő kihívást. A rendezvény célja, hogy a futók számára felejthetetlen élményt nyújtson, a kezdőktől a tapasztalt maratonistákig. A fővédnökök és védnökök támogatásával a maraton egy igazi bakancslistás kihívás, amely Budapest ikonikus helyszínein vezet keresztül.

name: Azuga Trail Race

price_tiers.distance: Sorica Sunset Vertical iluminat de VARTA

description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual chip timing, aid stations with water and fruit, finisher medals, cash and sports equipment prizes, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, and an official photo and video album. Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

description: Făget Tour GlobalLogic is a running race organized by Runners Club in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run in nature during one of the most beautiful times of the year. The event includes two main races: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country route in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic views
Routes marked and supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked, and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The race has official partners and supporters. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, offering an opportunity to discover the area's natural beauty and take part in a community sporting event.

name: ALERGAREA DE SAMBATA - CALARASI
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv Alergarea de Sâmbătă
description: Semimaratonul „Alergarea de Sâmbătă” din Călărași este un eveniment sportiv emblematic pentru comunitatea locală, care adună alergători amatori și profesioniști într-o competiție prietenoasă și motivantă. Traseul se desfășoară în Parcul Central, oferind o experiență plăcută și accesibilă pentru toți participanții. Atmosfera este una de susținere și camaraderie, cu facilități dedicate pentru confortul alergătorilor, inclusiv corturi pentru relaxare și prim-ajutor. Evenimentul promovează progresul personal și spiritul sportiv, fiind o ocazie excelentă de socializare și testare a rezistenței.

name: SEMIMARATONUL CRAIOVEI
description: Semimaratonul Craiovei este un eveniment de alergare cu strângere de fonduri dedicat comunității, organizat de Asociația Română a Tinerilor cu Inițiativă (A.R.T.I.) în colaborare cu SightRunning.ro. Evenimentul oferă curse cronometrate pentru alergători profesioniști pe distanțe de 21 km, 14 km și 7 km, precum și curse necronometrate și activități pentru toate vârstele și categorii, inclusiv persoane în fotolii rulante și animale de companie. Traseul este urban, cu start și finish la Esplanada Stadionului Ion Oblemenco, constând în bucle de 7 km, cu o diferență de nivel de 58 m. Participarea sprijină proiecte caritabile în domeniile educației, sănătății și incluziunii sociale, făcând din acest eveniment o ocazie de solidaritate și implicare comunitară.

name: PANORÁMA TRAIL
description: A Panoráma Trail egy különleges terepfutó maraton a Zempléni-hegységben, amely összeköti a Boldogkő, Regéc és Füzér történelmi várakat. A 45 kilométeres táv változatos, technikás erdei ösvényeken vezet, ahol a természet és a múlt találkozik. A verseny nem az időeredményekről szól, hanem az élményről és a kihívásról, amely egyéni vagy 3 fős csapatban is teljesíthető. A rendezvény prémium szervezéssel és környezettudatos szemlélettel várja a futókat októberben, ideális futóidőben.

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: A Panoráma Trail egy 45 kilométeres terepfutó verseny a Zempléni-hegységben, amely összeköti a Boldogkő, Regéc és Füzér történelmi várakat. A verseny nem az időeredményekről szól, hanem az élményről és a természet közelségéről, ahol a futók sziklás ösvényeken, patakokon átkelve, erdei környezetben haladnak. Egyéni és 3 fős csapatban is lehet nevezni, így akár közösen is átélhető a kihívás. A rendezvény prémium élményt kínál minden részletében, a rajtcsomagtól a célban kapott befutóéremig.

name: Írottkő Hegyi Futóverseny
description: Az Írottkő Hegyi Futóverseny egy különleges terepfutó esemény, amely a Kőszegi-hegység vadregényes tájain zajlik. Több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a rövid 7 km-es bevezetőtől a kihívást jelentő 102 km-es ultra távig, amely Ausztria területére is átnyúlik. A verseny változatos terepen, meredek emelkedőkön és erdők között halad, és a futók számára felejthetetlen élményt nyújt a természet közelsége és a panorámás kilátások. A verseny különlegessége a csapatban teljesíthető ultra táv, amely a közös élményt és kitartást helyezi előtérbe.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori
description: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori je tradicionalna sportsko-rekreativna manifestacija koja okuplja trkače na zahtevnim stazama kroz prelepu prirodu Fruške gore. Trke obuhvataju različite distance, od ultra ekstremnih do pripravničkih staza, prilagođene različitim nivoima spremnosti. Manifestacija se održava u Popovici kod Sremske Kamenice i pruža jedinstven spoj izazova i uživanja u prirodi. Organizatori obezbeđuju i organizovani prevoz do starta, kao i bogatu podršku tokom trke.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori 2026
description: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori je tradicionalna sportsko-takmičarska i rekreativna manifestacija koja okuplja ljubitelje planinskog trčanja i prirode. Trke se održavaju na zahtevnim stazama koje prolaze kroz prelepe predele Fruške gore, sa različitim dužinama i težinama, prilagođenim za različite nivoe takmičara. Manifestacija je poznata po dobroj organizaciji, bogatom programu i podršci brojnih sponzora i prijatelja maratona. Učesnici mogu da očekuju izazove na stazama sa značajnim usponima i spustevima, kao i nezaboravne prizore prirode.

name: II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail
description: A II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail egy festői futóverseny, amelyet 2026. október 18-án rendeznek meg Kötcsén, a Gutman Borpince környékén. A verseny a somogyi dombok között, a Csillagó-hegy és környékének panorámás útvonalain vezet, változatos távokkal, köztük félmaratonnal és páros váltóval. A résztvevők gyönyörű őszi szőlőültetvények, erdők és történelmi helyszínek között futhatnak, miközben a célban egyedi befutóérem és ajándékok várják őket. A rendezvény hangulatát a Csillagó Trail fesztivál borospohara is emeli, így a futás élménye mellett a helyi borok is megkóstolhatók.

name: Veresegyház Futónap
description: A Veresegyház Futónap egy családias hangulatú futóverseny, amely Veresegyház Búcsú tér környékén kerül megrendezésre. Több táv közül választhatnak a résztvevők, a mini futamtól a félmaratonig, egyéni és csapatban is lehet indulni. A verseny az Ötpróba program pontgyűjtő állomása is, így a résztvevők pontokat gyűjthetnek és jutalmakat szerezhetnek. A csapatban futás külön kategória, ahol háromfős csapatok versenyeznek, de minden csapattagnak egyénileg kell teljesítenie a távot. A rendezvény barátságos, közösségi esemény, amely a futás örömét és a sportos életmódot népszerűsíti.

name: Povlen Trail
description: Povlen Trail je deo serijala West Serbia Trails, koji povezuje planine, reke i doline zapadne Srbije kroz jedinstvene trail trke. Ova trka pruža trkačima priliku da istraže netaknutu prirodu i uživaju u izazovima planinskih staza. West Serbia Trails promoviše spoj sporta, prirode i zajednice, stvarajući nezaboravno iskustvo za sve učesnike.

name: Kamenica trejl 2026
description: Каменица трејл 2026 је прво коло Југ трејл серије, одржава се 18. октобра 2026. на излетишту Дабило код Ниша. Трка нуди две стазе: велику од 20,7 км са 810 метара успона и малу од 5,6 км са 240 метара успона, обе са стартом и циљем на истом месту. Трасе воде кроз шумске стазе, макадам и део асфалта, пружајући изазов и лепе призоре. Организатор је Тркачко-планинарско удружење „Running club Niš“, а учесници могу очекивати добру организацију, окрепу и награде.

name: Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail е планинско бягане, провеждащо се в района на Варна, България, с три различни дистанции, подходящи за различни нива на бегачи. Трасетата предлагат разнообразие от терени и красиви гледки към Черно море, като съчетават предизвикателни изкачвания и спускания. Събитието е чудесна възможност за любителите на природата и планинското бягане да се насладят на спорт и природа в едно.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra е планинско бягане, което съчетава красотата на планината и морето в района на Елените. Състезанието предлага четири дистанции - 4K, 12K, 28K и 50K, подходящи за различни нива на бегачи. Трасето преминава през живописни природни пътеки и предлага уникално изживяване сред природата. Събитието е част от международния маршрут Ком-Емине и привлича бегачи, търсещи предизвикателство и вдъхновение.

name: 34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: Състезанието „Димитър Върбанов - Митето“ в град Койнаре е традиционно лекоатлетическо събитие с над 30-годишна история, включващо полумаратони, шосейни бягания и турнири на писта. В последните години се провежда и турнир по спортно ходене, който привлича атлети от различни градове в България. Организаторите от СКА „Спартак - Койнаре“ осигуряват професионална организация и състезания за всички възрасти. Събитието е известно с участието на най-добрите български бегачи и спортни ходачи.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail-running race that winds through the wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hidden in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the grueling climb up Szádvár, panoramic views from Esztramos Hill, and the atmospheric wine-cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This challenging race welcomes adventure-seekers to Szögliget in October.
course_highlights: The wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
A monastery ruin nestled among the trees
Panoramic views from Esztramos Hill
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, on varied terrain featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online and enjoy the scenic landscape and challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race takes place in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps. Those who would prefer to run fewer laps may do so. The race has a voluntary entry fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place at the venue. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The race route is four laps covering the half-marathon distance
Participants may complete fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 HUF per lap. Participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. The top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. Hilly terrain; four laps for a half marathon; options to run fewer laps; refreshments provided; medals for all; awards for top finishers.

name: Viking Challenge Trail
location: Fruška Gora - Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Viking Challenge is a race held on Fruška Gora, with courses of varying distances suited to all ages and running abilities. Participants can choose courses from 1 km to 22 km, enjoying well-marked terrain and support from volunteers. The race offers electronic timing, medals, promotional T-shirts, as well as refreshments and a meal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with an emphasis on community and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses of 1 km, 5.5 km, 11 km, and 22 km on Fruška Gora
Well-marked courses with support from volunteers and spectators
Electronic timing and GPX files available for navigation
additional: Starts are assigned in groups according to registration dates, with no option to change groups. Participants receive a medal, promotional T-shirt, race photos, water, juice, and energy drinks, as well as a meal after the race. Medical assistance is available in case of injury. Trail race, electronic timing, GPX route files available, post-race gathering

name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge, starting and finishing in Ovčar Banja. The 22.4 km race, with 1,600 metres of cumulative elevation gain, runs through forested terrain, technically challenging rocky sections and over two Kablar peaks, offering runners a challenge and beautiful panoramic views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The race is part of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national series and is intended for both experienced runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and test their abilities. It is organised by the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club of Čačak, which is celebrating its 75th anniversary this year and guarantees good organisation and safety during the race.
course_highlights: 22.4 km long with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava River, Ovčar, Jelica and Debela Gora
additional: The race is certified and awards 1 ITRA point. The time limit is 4 hours for competitors in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia national series and 5 hours for others. The start and finish are at the Nature Centre in Ovčar Banja. The organiser provides clear course marking and safety on the route. The course is certified and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia series; appropriate equipment is mandatory, and prizes are provided for the top finishers. The race is part of the national mountain-running series and marks the 75th anniversary of the “Kablar” Mountaineering Club.

name: Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: The Eastern Rhodopes race is an ultrarunning event held in the Krumovgrad area, known for its rich biodiversity and mystical history. The courses pass through unique natural phenomena and megalithic monuments, such as Sheytan Dere and Kovil, offering challenging technical descents and climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the wilderness and adventurous spirit of the Eastern Rhodopes. The organizers provide course marking, medals, timing and photographers, and participants can also run with pets. The use of reusable water bottles is encouraged.
course_highlights: Courses pass by megalithic monuments such as Kovil and natural phenomena such as Sheytan Dere
Technical descents and climbs with moderate elevation gain
Pets are welcome, with water and treats available at the aid stations
additional: Course marking, medals, timing and photographers are provided. Participants can run with pets, with water and treats available for them at the aid stations. Reusable water bottles or cups are recommended to reduce plastic use. Courses: 67 km, 37 km, 22 km, 4 km; registration and participation with support for pets; environmental requirements.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championship in Koynare is a prestigious competition that brings together athletes from across Bulgaria for challenging races in a natural and demanding setting. The event offers young and experienced runners the opportunity to compete on varied terrain suited to cross country. The organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accurate and transparent rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Suitable for all age groups and fitness levels
Professional timing using RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and a real-time participant list. Certified timing equipment is used, with live results optimized for mobile devices and computers. The date is 2026-10-24. The race will take place in Koynare, organized by Race Timing BG. The course is in the area around the town.

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Victory Square, offering a unique experience inspired by the story of Eugeniu of Savoy’s arrival. The half marathon and fun runs offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and the special anniversary race “106 pentru POLI”.
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric district along the banks of the Bega
The fun runs pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric district
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. Marathon participants depart by coach for Otelec at 06:30 from Victory Square. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, a Pasta Party, and the anniversary race “106 pentru POLI” on October 29, 2026, at Stadionul Știința. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

name: Beiuș Running Day
price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children’s race, a 10 km race, and a 21.1 km half marathon, on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, an eco-friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It’s a great opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km race and half marathon
Children’s race on fully safe paved routes closed to vehicle traffic
Hydration stations and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children’s race is free and open to children aged 4 to 13, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on fully safe routes closed to vehicle traffic. A parent or guardian must be present with participating children throughout the race. Medals, certificates, and product prizes are awarded to all participants, and the adult routes include hydration stations and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes, including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity in the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, Family Run, and a race for people with special abilities, “I CAN TOO!” The courses pass through forests, hills, and historic sites such as the Royal Hațeg Fortress, offering a technical and spectacular experience. The event is praised for its clear course markings and friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Courses through forests and hills, with technical climbs and descents
Passage by the Royal Hațeg Fortress, an iconic historic site
Varied scenery including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and the village of Covragiu
additional: Race kits can be collected between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The 6 km cross-country race, 12 km cross-country race, and half marathon start at 10:00, while the Family Run and “I CAN TOO!” races start at 15:00. Registration for the children’s races and Family Run is also available on site, subject to availability. Due to manufacturing tolerances, runners are advised to choose a T-shirt size smaller than their usual size. The event offers cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Hațeg Country area.

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race held in the heart of Serbia, in the Gledić Mountains, offering runners a unique opportunity to experience unspoiled nature across forests, meadows, and mountain ridges. The race features three courses of different lengths and difficulty levels: Lane (12 km), Srna (22 km), and Jelen (ultra, 58 km). All courses are well marked and pass through beautiful natural scenery. This event is more than just a race; it is a gathering of people who share a passion for nature and adventure, with a comprehensive race package and on-course support. The start is scheduled for October 31, 2026, with time limits tailored to the course distances.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the forests, meadows, and ridges of the Gledić Mountains
Three courses of different lengths: 12 km, 22 km, and 58 km, with significant elevation gain
Beautiful viewpoints and authentic natural landscapes
additional: The race package includes a race-logo T-shirt, medal, chip-timed bib, aid stations, professional photographs, sponsor gifts, and lunch for participants. The courses are marked and secured. The time limit for the longest course is 12 hours, and for the middle-distance course, 6 hours.
